expressive-accent.prior: a restrained base lets a single bold color carry emotional emphasis, drawing attention to what matters most

maximize-information-density.prior: Every element should carry meaningful signal, so pack the most relevant information into the least space without sacrificing clarity.

moves.restrained-neutral-chrome: 9-step gray ramp (--gray-0 #08090a through --gray-8 #f4f5f6) forms nearly all grounds, borders, and text (bg var(--gray-0), border var(--gray-3), color var(--gray-7)/var(--gray-5))
moves.expressive-accent: single indigo --accent #5e6ad2 with --accent-hover #7c89e8 as the sole non-neutral color, used sparingly (color: '#5e6ad2')

application.evidence: page background uses the darkest neutral --gray-0 (#08090a)
Panel background --gray-1 (#131417) raises a container off the near-black ground
foreground uses a graded neutral ramp: --gray-8 headings, --gray-7 body, --gray-5/6 muted labels
borders/dividers use --gray-3 (#26282d) throughout Panel and globals
the single saturated hue --accent #5e6ad2 (with --accent-hover #7c89e8) is the only non-neutral color, appearing solely as a foreground accent within Panel — never on ground, surface, or borders
